description: StateBlock 模块日志消息注册文件 - StateBlockLog（StateHoldDriven 池运行时过程步日志：spawn / 探活 / 预热 / 请求 / 超时归因）

StateBlock_WarmupFailed.template: 预热失败: pool={pool}, worker={workerId}, stage={stage}, stderrTail={stderrTail}, error={error}

StateBlock_WarmupHung.template: 预热挂起: pool={pool}, worker={workerId}, stage={stage}, phase={phase}, stderrTail={stderrTail}, error={error}

StateBlock_ReadyTimeoutCleanup.template: 就绪预算耗尽/取消，清理未就绪 daemon: pool={pool}, warm={warm}, workers={workers}

StateBlock_DaemonTrace.template: daemon trace: pool={pool}, worker={workerId}, stage={stage}, detail={detail}

StateBlock_DaemonCsg.template: daemon csg: pool={pool}, worker={workerId}, stage={stage}, form={form}

StateBlock_DaemonCsgTransition.template: daemon csg 迁移: pool={pool}, worker={workerId}, state={stage}

StateBlock_SendStart.template: 请求开始: pool={pool}, requestId={requestId}, worker={workerId}, cmd={cmd}, remainingSec={remainingSec}

StateBlock_SendDone.template: 请求完成: pool={pool}, requestId={requestId}, worker={workerId}, cmd={cmd}, elapsedMs={elapsedMs}

StateBlock_SendRetry.template: 基建故障换 worker 重试: pool={pool}, requestId={requestId}, worker={workerId}, cmd={cmd}, attempt={attempt}, error={error}, lastStage={lastStage}, stderrTail={stderrTail}

StateBlock_SendFailed.template: 请求业务失败: pool={pool}, requestId={requestId}, worker={workerId}, cmd={cmd}, error={error}, lastStage={lastStage}, stderrTail={stderrTail}

StateBlock_SendCancelled.template: 请求被取消: pool={pool}, requestId={requestId}, worker={workerId}, cmd={cmd}, error={error}

StateBlock_WorkerExited.template: worker 进程退出(被 kill/崩溃): pool={pool}, worker={workerId}

StateBlock_RespawnFailed.template: 补位/重启失败: pool={pool}, worker={workerId}, error={error}

StateBlock_IllegalTransition.template: 非法 worker 状态迁移: pool={pool}, worker={workerId}, from={from}, to={to}

StateBlock_BackpressureWait.template: 背压等待可用 worker: pool={pool}, ready={readyCount}

StateBlock_WarmupSummary.template: 预热汇总: pool={pool}, warmed={warmed}, total={total}

StateBlock_PoolInit.template: 池初始化: pool={pool}, poolSize={poolSize}, idleTimeoutSec={idleTimeoutSec}, warmupBudgetSec={warmupBudgetSec}, infraRetries={infraRetries}
